entries.intro_zh: 封套上写着“倒计时八音盒”；用完以后，磁带和纸壳都不会回来。

entries.icon_reason: 乐谱表现八音盒的定时演奏

entries.intro_en: The sleeve is marked “Curtain-Call Bell”. Once spent, neither tape nor paper comes back.

entries.description_en: Mark three visible tiles. The next three real collisions each borrow one marked tile to amplify their sound; then the box is empty.
entries.intro_zh: 封套上写着“一盒尚未发生的掌声”；用完以后，磁带和纸壳都不会回来。
entries.intro_en: The sleeve is marked “A Box of Applause That Hasn’t Happened”. Once spent, neither tape nor paper comes back.

entries.description_en: Tool. Provides directional light; turning it costs a real action, and it cannot illuminate behind you.

verb.zh: 朝一个方向照明并用行动转向
verb.en: illuminate one direction and spend an action to turn

complement.zh: 背后不会受光
complement.en: does not light the space behind you

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 朝向性照明落成「正面锥多一格预算、背向少一格」：转向是一次真实行动，方向存在自己的刻痕里，不跟着脚步走。

entries.description_zh: 衣物；强光负面积累降低，但暗处辨认距离也缩短。
entries.description_en: Clothing. Reduces buildup from intense light, but shortens how far you can make things out in darkness.
entries.intro_zh: 停电后的工作台上，磨砂护目片仍带着一圈淡淡的光痕。
entries.intro_en: On the workbench after the blackout, the Frosted Goggles still carried a faint ring of light.

modifier.en: glare buffer with shorter dark sight

verb.zh: 减轻强光累积
verb.en: reduce buildup from intense light

complement.zh: 暗处辨认距离也会变短
complement.en: also shortens recognition distance in darkness

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 本作唯一的「强光负面」是闪光致盲：护目片把致盲覆盖从清零改为减半，代价是暗处辨认距离 −1（走同一条平减通道）。

entries.description_zh: 装备；持续读法：维持外光充能：在外部固定灯照明下度过一个真实回合，储存一次构想直接创伤加1；最多一份、保持4回合，每4回合至多充能一次，自身与自己生成的光不充能；补语读法：使本次伤害构想首个直接受伤敌人致盲1回合；每6回合至多一次，沿用目标的致盲免疫与结束保护。
entries.description_en: Equipment. Sustained reading: sustain external-light charging: one real turn under an external fixed lamp stores one +1-trauma direct-construct hit for 4 turns, with one charge maximum and a 4-turn recharge cooldown; personal and self-created light cannot charge it. Complement reading: blind the first enemy directly damaged by this construct for 1 turn, at most once every 6 turns, respecting blindness immunity and end protection.
entries.intro_zh: 停电后的工作台上，蓄光袖扣仍带着一圈淡淡的光痕。
entries.intro_en: On the workbench after the blackout, the Photoluminescent Cufflink still carried a faint ring of light.

modifier.en: spend an external-light charge after a direct hit to add 1 trauma to the first enemy directly damaged by this construct

verb.zh: 维持外光充能：在外部固定灯照明下度过一个真实回合，储存一次构想直接创伤加1；最多一份、保持4回合，每4回合至多充能一次，自身与自己生成的光不充能
verb.en: sustain external-light charging: one real turn under an external fixed lamp stores one +1-trauma direct-construct hit for 4 turns, with one charge maximum and a 4-turn recharge cooldown; personal and self-created light cannot charge it

complement.zh: 使本次伤害构想首个直接受伤敌人致盲1回合；每6回合至多一次，沿用目标的致盲免疫与结束保护
complement.en: blind the first enemy directly damaged by this construct for 1 turn, at most once every 6 turns, respecting blindness immunity and end protection

manner.zh: 在已有外光充能时，使本次构想首个直接受伤敌人多受1点创伤；成功命中后消耗充能
manner.en: spend an external-light charge after a direct hit to add 1 trauma to the first enemy directly damaged by this construct

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 原储光只能照脚下，收益不够形成构筑；把外部光能转为一次构想增伤。
mechanic_proposal.replaced_description_zh: 饰品；在外部光源旁停留后储一份弱光，只够照脚下，不能自照自充。

modifier.zh: 借助蓄光袖扣，在已有外光充能时，使本次构想首个直接受伤敌人多受1点创伤；成功命中后消耗充能。
modifier.en: Wearing Photoluminescent Cufflink, I spend an external-light charge after a direct hit to add 1 trauma to the first enemy directly damaged by this construct.

verb.zh: 我佩戴蓄光袖扣，维持外光充能：在外部固定灯照明下度过一个真实回合，储存一次构想直接创伤加1；最多一份、保持4回合，每4回合至多充能一次，自身与自己生成的光不充能。
verb.en: Wearing Photoluminescent Cufflink, I sustain external-light charging: one real turn under an external fixed lamp stores one +1-trauma direct-construct hit for 4 turns, with one charge maximum and a 4-turn recharge cooldown; personal and self-created light cannot charge it.

complement.zh: 借由蓄光袖扣，使本次伤害构想首个直接受伤敌人致盲1回合；每6回合至多一次，沿用目标的致盲免疫与结束保护。
complement.en: Wearing Photoluminescent Cufflink, I blind the first enemy directly damaged by this construct for 1 turn, at most once every 6 turns, respecting blindness immunity and end protection.

entries.description_zh: 武器；攻击时短闪照出出手方向，同时使自己更容易被看见。
entries.description_en: Weapon. Briefly lights the direction of an attack, making you easier to see at the same time.
entries.intro_zh: 停电后的工作台上，漏光的拆信刀仍带着一圈淡淡的光痕。

verb.en: flash light along the direction of an attack

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 真实命中后沿出手方向短闪一段（那几格这一回合算被照亮），同时异象看你多一格——不新写一套方向光，只借用临时照亮与一次半径比较。

entries.description_en: Tool. Switches between a long, narrow beam and a short, wide beam. Switching costs an action, and both modes use the same finite battery.
entries.intro_zh: 停电后的工作台上，窄缝手电仍带着一圈淡淡的光痕。
entries.intro_en: On the workbench after the blackout, the Slit-Beam Flashlight still carried a faint ring of light.

verb.zh: 切换长窄束与短宽束
verb.en: switch between a long narrow and short wide beam

complement.zh: 切换花行动，两模式共用有限电量
complement.en: switching costs an action; both modes share finite power

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 两档共用一个电量池：长窄束走正向锥 +2、短宽束整圈 +1，切换花一次行动；亮着每回合烧 1 点，烧完自动关。

entries.description_zh: 工具；拆装一盏合法环境灯的罩子改变散射形状，须近身，不能复制灯源。
entries.description_en: Tool. Changes the spread of a compatible environmental lamp by removing and refitting its shade at close range. It does not create another light source.
entries.intro_zh: 停电后的工作台上，搬家的灯罩仍带着一圈淡淡的光痕。
entries.intro_en: On the workbench after the blackout, the Portable Lampshade still carried a faint ring of light.

verb.zh: 近身拆装兼容环境灯的灯罩
verb.en: remove or refit a compatible environmental lampshade at close range

complement.zh: 改变散射但不复制灯源
complement.en: changes the spread without copying the light source

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 近身拆装一盏亮着的灯的罩子：拆下半径 +1（散得更开），装回收拢；只改既有灯的光圈，不复制灯源。

entries.description_zh: 衣物；降低自身携灯向背面的漏光，也削掉自己背面照明。
entries.description_en: Clothing. Reduces light leaking from your carried lamp behind you, and also dims your own rearward illumination.
entries.intro_zh: 停电后的工作台上，黑布背心仍带着一圈淡淡的光痕。
entries.intro_en: On the workbench after the blackout, the Blackcloth Vest still carried a faint ring of light.

verb.zh: 压低携灯向身后的漏光
verb.en: reduce light leaking from your carried lamp behind you

complement.zh: 同时减弱自己的背向照明
complement.en: also dims your own rearward illumination

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 背向遮光两面都算：自己背后少一格视野，站在背后的异象看你也少一格；正面与别处一律不受影响。

entries.description_zh: 装备；持续读法：维持击杀回流：构想直接击杀敌人后返还1点想象力；每次施放最多一次、冷却4回合，所有返还合计不得使本次净消耗低于1；补语读法：在本次构想成功施放后获得一份清醒护持，2回合内下一次清醒创伤减少1、最低为1，触发即消耗；冷却4回合。
entries.description_en: Equipment. Sustained reading: sustain on-kill return: a direct construct kill returns 1 Imagination, once per cast with a 4-turn cooldown; combined refunds cannot lower that cast's net cost below 1. Complement reading: gain one Lucidity guard after this successful construct: the next Lucidity trauma within 2 turns is reduced by 1 to a minimum of 1, consuming the guard; cooldown 4 turns.

verb.zh: 维持击杀回流：构想直接击杀敌人后返还1点想象力；每次施放最多一次、冷却4回合，所有返还合计不得使本次净消耗低于1

complement.zh: 在本次构想成功施放后获得一份清醒护持，2回合内下一次清醒创伤减少1、最低为1，触发即消耗；冷却4回合
complement.en: gain one Lucidity guard after this successful construct: the next Lucidity trauma within 2 turns is reduced by 1 to a minimum of 1, consuming the guard; cooldown 4 turns

manner.zh: 在本次构想直接击杀敌人后返还1点想象力，但该次施放的净消耗至少为1；每4回合至多一次
manner.en: return 1 Imagination after this construct directly kills an enemy, leaving a net casting cost of at least 1, at most once every 4 turns

modifier.zh: 借助回光别针，在本次构想直接击杀敌人后返还1点想象力，但该次施放的净消耗至少为1；每4回合至多一次。
modifier.en: Wearing Afterglow Pin, I return 1 Imagination after this construct directly kills an enemy, leaving a net casting cost of at least 1, at most once every 4 turns.

verb.zh: 我佩戴回光别针，维持击杀回流：构想直接击杀敌人后返还1点想象力；每次施放最多一次、冷却4回合，所有返还合计不得使本次净消耗低于1。
verb.en: Wearing Afterglow Pin, I sustain on-kill return: a direct construct kill returns 1 Imagination, once per cast with a 4-turn cooldown; combined refunds cannot lower that cast's net cost below 1.

complement.en: Wearing Afterglow Pin, I gain one Lucidity guard after this successful construct: the next Lucidity trauma within 2 turns is reduced by 1 to a minimum of 1, consuming the guard; cooldown 4 turns.

modifier.zh: 挪用部分光线的短直束
modifier.en: short beam diverted from a lamp

verb.zh: 把已见灯光引向一条短直线
verb.en: redirect part of a known lamp’s light into a short line

complement.zh: 原照明区随之缩小
complement.en: the lamp’s original lit area shrinks

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 成对选点（已见的灯 → 方向）：把一段直束记成临时照亮，原灯半径 −1，到期一起还原；同一盏灯同时只引一条光。

entries.description_zh: 装备；持续读法：维持构想扩幅，使具有显式半径的伤害波、感知场或软控制场半径增加1格，每次额外支付2点想象力；不扩大位移、召唤、材料生成或地形改写；补语读法：使本次构想保持原作用范围并少耗1点想象力，最低为1；同件本次已扩幅时不再采用此聚束读法。

entries.description_zh: 首次遭遇移动强光时获得一份眩光时长缓冲，冷却与源绑定。
entries.description_en: On your first encounter with moving intense light, buffers some of its glare duration. The cooldown is bound to the light source.
entries.intro_zh: 那晚的光没有照亮房间，只留下雨夜的车灯的记忆。
entries.intro_en: The light that night never reached the room; it left only the memory of headlights in the rain.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 眩光时长缓冲挂在 `portent:blinded`（授予时少挂一回合）；「冷却与源绑定」本作用「按层一次」表达——没有可绑定的光源实例（眩光由光场授予，不带实例 id），所以退一档，写在这里而不是假装做到了。

entries.description_zh: 清醒度见底前的第一下环境损耗少 2 点，每层一次；不制造光、也不隐身。
entries.description_en: The first environmental lucidity loss each layer costs 2 less; it creates no light and grants no stealth.
entries.intro_zh: 那晚的光没有照亮房间，只留下母亲留下的床头灯的记忆。
entries.intro_en: The light that night never reached the room; it left only the memory of Mother’s bedside lamp.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文是**主动**动作（「可主动耗掉本层一次储备微光」），本作没有「主动消耗储备光」这个动词，加它要另开资源与按钮；按改描述裁定改成被动缓冲：环境清醒损耗每层第一次少 2 点（`lucidity:environment`），并明写「不制造光、不隐身」以对齐原文的边界。

entries.intro_en: The workbook calls this move “Trim the Light”: one action for a brief change to the light field.

entries.intro_zh: 小盒写着“遗失相机的闪灯”；启用后只够撑过眼前的一次险情。

entries.description_zh: 消耗后让携灯短时只照前方，不抑制其他声光来源。

entries.intro_zh: 小盒写着“黑纸灯套”；启用后只够撑过眼前的一次险情。
entries.intro_en: The small box reads “Black-Paper Lamp Sleeve”; once activated, it lasts for the immediate emergency only.

entries.intro_zh: 小盒写着“应急磷片”；启用后只够撑过眼前的一次险情。

entries.intro_zh: 小盒写着“借来的一束白昼”；启用后只够撑过眼前的一次险情。
entries.intro_en: The small box reads “A Borrowed Beam of Daylight”; once activated, it lasts for the immediate emergency only.

entries.intro_en: The small box reads “Overexposed Film”; once activated, it lasts for the immediate emergency only.

entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，栏杆挂钩还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Rail Hook was still in the lowest patch of ground.

board_art.motif: 栏杆挂钩 · 地势与液气·🪝

verb.zh: 把自己的小容器固定在合法承载面
verb.en: anchor your small container to a legal support surface

complement.zh: 腾出手位，取回仍须靠近
complement.en: frees the hand slot; retrieval still requires proximity

entries.description_zh: 衣物；被液体冲移时更稳，平地移动更慢，不免液体侵扰。
entries.description_en: Clothing. Helps you resist being swept aside by liquid, but slows movement on level ground. They do not protect you from liquid exposure.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，塞满砂的鞋套还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Sand-Filled Overshoes were still in the lowest patch of ground.

board_art.motif: 塞满砂的鞋套 · 地势与液气·🥾

verb.zh: 在液流冲移时稳住脚步
verb.en: steady your footing against a liquid current

complement.zh: 平地移动变慢，仍会受液体侵扰
complement.en: slows you on level ground and does not prevent liquid exposure

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 步伐更沉：每次移动多付 1 点时间。描述里的「被液体冲移时更稳」本作没有液体推移载具（玩家不会被水推走），这一半没有落点，只兑现了更慢的一半。

entries.description_zh: 工具；相邻一格地势降一档，限可改地板，铲土实际留在另一合法格。
entries.description_en: Tool. Lowers one adjacent, modifiable floor cell by one elevation step. The removed soil is deposited in another legal cell.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，折口排水铲还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Folded Drain Spade was still in the lowest patch of ground.

verb.zh: 优先抽取容器里当前可取的液体

complement.zh: 不穿层，也不恢复已混合材料

entries.description_zh: 饰品；把一个合法小工具固定于中层承载点，支撑损坏就掉落，不提高投射物高度。
entries.description_en: Accessory. Holds one legal small tool at a mid-level support point. If its support breaks, the tool falls; this does not raise projectile height.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，登高的画板夹还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Raised Drawing-Board Clip was still in the lowest patch of ground.

verb.zh: 把一件合法小工具夹在中层承载点

complement.zh: 支撑损坏时掉落，不抬高投射物
complement.en: falls if its support breaks and does not raise projectiles

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 把一件未上盘的小工具固定到合法承载点上（释放行囊位置），支撑面被改就掉回地面；不改变任何投射物高度。

entries.description_zh: 武器；命中液体附着目标时把一份附着甩回相邻落点，自己有接触风险。
entries.description_en: Weapon. When it hits a target carrying liquid, flicks one unit of that buildup onto an adjacent landing cell. You risk contact yourself.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，潮线刺针还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Tide-Line Awl was still in the lowest patch of ground.

verb.zh: 命中带液目标时甩出一份附着
verb.en: flick one unit of buildup from a liquid-coated target on hit

complement.zh: 转移时自己也有接触风险
complement.en: you risk contact while transferring it

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 命中带液体附着的目标时剥掉 1 份附着，液体落回自己脚下——所以有接触风险，可能顺势沾上。只对液体类附着有效。

entries.description_zh: 工具；把真实液体送往较高相邻格，耗想象且出口容量不足就停。
entries.description_en: Tool. Sends real liquid to a higher adjacent cell at an imagination cost. Stops if the outlet lacks capacity.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，抽水员的反向泵还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Pumper’s Reversing Pump was still in the lowest patch of ground.

verb.zh: 耗想象力把液体送往较高邻格
verb.en: spend imagination to pump liquid to a higher adjacent cell

complement.zh: 出口容量不足就停止
complement.en: stops when the outlet lacks capacity

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 把液体送上更高的相邻格，花 1 点想象力；出口满或没有高差就整次拒绝，不消耗。

entries.icon_reason: 活塞抽压器类比反向泵

entries.description_zh: 衣物；主动封闭外层三回合减少液体新附着，同时不能盛取与喷射。
entries.description_en: Clothing. Actively seals its outer layer for three turns, reducing new liquid buildup. While sealed, you cannot scoop or spray liquid.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，沉箱工作服还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Caisson Work Suit was still in the lowest patch of ground.

board_art.motif: 沉箱工作服 · 地势与液气·🥼

verb.zh: 主动封住外层以减少新附着
verb.en: seal the outer layer to reduce new buildup

complement.zh: 三回合内不能盛取或喷射
complement.en: prevents scooping or spraying for three turns

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 封闭外层三回合：期间不沾新的液体附着，同时禁止盛装与喷射；不免疫已有征兆。

entries.description_en: Tool. Divides a finite liquid flow between two outlets at a chosen ratio. If one outlet clogs, its share does not magically increase the other’s.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，分流的黄铜闸还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Split-Flow Brass Gate was still in the lowest patch of ground.

verb.zh: 按设定比例分配两条出口的液流
verb.en: divide flow between two outlets at a chosen ratio

complement.zh: 一端堵塞不会把余量凭空给另一端
complement.en: a blockage does not conjure extra flow for the other outlet

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 两条出口各分 2 份，另一端堵住时只停那一侧，剩余量不会凭空加到另一侧。

entries.description_zh: 工具；展开可回收低矮阻液边界，不封气、不当高墙，承压损坏后不能完整收回。
entries.description_en: Tool. Deploys a recoverable low barrier that slows liquid without sealing gas or acting as a high wall. If pressure damages it, it cannot be fully recovered.
entries.intro_zh: 泥水退去后，能收起的堤岸还留在地势最低的那一格。
entries.intro_en: After the mud receded, the Retractable Embankment was still in the lowest patch of ground.

board_art.motif: 能收起的堤岸 · 地势与液气·▱

verb.zh: 展开低矮边界阻挡液体
verb.en: deploy a low barrier to impede liquid

complement.zh: 不挡气也非高墙，受压损坏后无法完整回收
complement.en: does not block gas or act as a high wall; pressure damage prevents full recovery

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 在两格之间立一道低矮阻液边界，液体不穿；压差超过 60 就损坏并撤销，之后不能完整收回。只挡液体，不封气、不当墙。

entries.icon_reason: 可折收的斜框表现堤岸结构

entries.description_zh: 先观察已见落差再倒液，可把一次倾倒拆成两段确认，中途停止保留未倒材料。
entries.description_en: After inspecting a drop you have seen, you can divide one pour into two confirmed steps. Stopping midway leaves the unpoured material intact.
entries.intro_zh: 测绘本以“先看落差”记下地面变化的边缘。
entries.intro_en: The survey notebook records the edge of a change in the ground as “Check the Drop First.”

entries.name_en: A Table Is Not the Floor
entries.description_zh: 从相邻的陷阱石台取物时多站一回合，这一回合把机关隔开——陷阱不踩响，石台照旧发信号，机关石台照旧触发。
entries.description_en: Taking something from an adjacent trap slab takes one extra turn standing still: that turn keeps the mechanism off you — the trap does not fire, the slab still signals, and trigger slabs still trigger as usual.
entries.intro_zh: 测绘本以“桌面不是地面”记下地面变化的边缘。
entries.intro_en: The survey notebook records the edge of a change in the ground as “A Table Is Not the Floor.”
entries.icon_reason: 承托横面形表现桌面与地面的区别

entries.description_zh: 比较两次亲见存量判断正在积聚或消退，不在视野外继续更新。
entries.description_en: By comparing two amounts you have witnessed, you can tell whether a puddle is growing or receding. It does not keep updating outside your view.
entries.intro_zh: 测绘本以“积水的年龄”记下地面变化的边缘。
entries.intro_en: The survey notebook records the edge of a change in the ground as “Age of a Puddle.”

entries.description_zh: 在已见气体边缘等待，可标出本回合真实扩散方向，不显示墙后气体。
entries.description_en: Wait at the edge of visible gas to mark its real direction of spread this turn. Gas behind walls remains unknown.
entries.intro_zh: 测绘本以“蒸气的出口”记下地面变化的边缘。
entries.intro_en: The survey notebook records the edge of a change in the ground as “Where the Steam Escapes.”

entries.description_zh: 已知导流网络逆流时提示哪个已见出口发生变化，仍需重新观察确认原因。
entries.description_en: When a known flow network reverses, this points out which visible outlet changed. You must inspect again to confirm why.
entries.intro_zh: 测绘本以“看见回流”记下地面变化的边缘。
entries.intro_en: The survey notebook records the edge of a change in the ground as “Spot the Backflow.”

entries.description_zh: 同一格等相变结束后首次取液，可避开一次表面接触附着，不能跳过伤害。
entries.description_en: After a phase change ends in a cell, your first liquid pickup there avoids one surface-contact buildup. It does not prevent damage.
entries.intro_zh: 测绘本以“先让它沉下去”记下地面变化的边缘。
entries.intro_en: The survey notebook records the edge of a change in the ground as “Let It Settle First.”
entries.icon_reason: 重量平衡表现让物体沉下去

entries.name_en: The Day My Rain Boots Filled
entries.description_zh: 第一次湿润附着的积累较低，离液晾干后按冷却恢复，不给涉水全免。
entries.description_en: The first time you gain wet buildup, it accumulates more slowly. After leaving the liquid and drying off, the effect recovers on a cooldown; it does not make you immune to water.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆从一串湿脚印开始，末尾只剩雨靴灌水那天。
entries.intro_en: This memory begins with a trail of wet footprints and ends with the day my rain boots filled.

effect.short_en: First dampness lasts a turn less

entries.description_zh: 一次麻痹短一回合；脚下的液体照旧拖慢。
entries.description_en: One numbness lasts one turn less; liquid still slows you as before.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆从一串湿脚印开始，末尾只剩扶栏下楼。
entries.intro_en: This memory begins with a trail of wet footprints and ends with a handrail on the stairs.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「真实地势改变引发的失衡缓冲」绑着本作不存在的「失衡」状态（地势变化不造成任何负面）。按裁定改成扶住扶手这件事最接近的既有效果：麻痹（脚下发木）少挂一回合。

entries.icon_reason: 长杆支撑轮廓类比楼梯扶栏

entries.description_zh: 短暂接触热蒸气后离开可更快恢复，持续处在蒸气中无效。
entries.description_en: After brief contact with hot steam, leaving it helps you recover faster. It has no effect while you remain in the steam.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆从一串湿脚印开始，末尾只剩蒸笼旁的白雾。
entries.intro_en: This memory begins with a trail of wet footprints and ends with white fog beside the steamer.

entries.description_zh: 脚步每层第一次少传一格；液体造成的拖慢本身照常。
entries.description_en: Your first footstep each layer carries one tile less; liquid slowness still applies.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆从一串湿脚印开始，末尾只剩湿纸上的鞋印。
entries.intro_en: This memory begins with a trail of wet footprints and ends with footprints on wet paper.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「液体拖慢结束后保留一次平稳起步」有两处空白：本作没有「拖慢结束」这个事件，也没有「一步零耗时」的可赠资源（`free_liquid_moves` 只来自物品本身）。按改描述裁定落到同一件东西实际会产生的结果上：脚步这一类每层第一次少传一格（`noise:step`）。

entries.description_zh: 一次润泽短一回合；液体造成的拖慢本身照常。
entries.description_en: One drenching lasts one turn less; the slowness of standing in liquid is unchanged.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆从一串湿脚印开始，末尾只剩水位没过膝盖。
entries.intro_en: This memory begins with a trail of wet footprints and ends with water up to the knees.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文是**主动**动作（「可主动付心智缓冲一回合迟滞」），本作没有这个动词。按裁定改成被动的一半：被液体浸透时的「润泽」少挂一回合，拖慢照旧。

entries.name_en: The Rain Gutter Outside the Window
entries.description_zh: 一次腐蚀短一回合；被腐蚀掉的容器内容物不会回来。
entries.description_en: One corrosion lasts one turn less; whatever it already ate does not come back.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆从一串湿脚印开始，末尾只剩窗台外的雨槽。
entries.intro_en: This memory begins with a trail of wet footprints and ends with the rain gutter outside the window.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「承载面倒塌后保住一件小容器的内容」需要「承载面倒塌 + 容器内容掉落」这条链，本作没有（容器是墙格与实物两种，倒坍不搬内容）。按裁定改成雨槽能兑现的那半句：腐蚀少挂一回合，且明写已损失的内容不返。

entries.description_zh: 吸入定量真实液体后变成湿砖，不能再吸；挤出会损失部分容积。
entries.description_en: Soaks up a measured amount of real liquid and becomes a wet brick that cannot absorb again. Squeezing it out loses some capacity.
entries.intro_zh: 封口纸写着“吸水纸砖”；打开后，里面的材料只够使用一次。
entries.intro_en: The sealed wrapper reads “Water-Absorbing Paper Brick”; the contents are enough for one use.
entries.icon_reason: 吸水多孔体类比吸水纸砖

entries.description_zh: 一次推开近处有限气体，危险气体仍会在下游伤人。
entries.description_en: Once, pushes away a finite amount of nearby gas. Dangerous gas can still harm targets farther downwind.
entries.intro_zh: 封口纸写着“泄气的折扇”；打开后，里面的材料只够使用一次。
entries.intro_en: The sealed wrapper reads “Leaking Fan”; the contents are enough for one use.
entries.icon_reason: 吹风意象表现折扇泄气

entries.description_zh: 生成一段有限寿命的低槽，仅导现有液体，结束后留下惰性残材。
entries.description_en: Creates a low trough with a limited lifetime. It redirects only existing liquid; when it expires, inert residue remains.
entries.intro_zh: 封口纸写着“快硬排水槽”；打开后，里面的材料只够使用一次。
entries.intro_en: The sealed wrapper reads “Quick-Setting Drain Trough”; the contents are enough for one use.

entries.description_zh: 暂封一个非任务容器的破口，受热或碰撞破裂后再次漏液。
entries.description_en: Temporarily plugs a breach in a non-quest container. Heat or impact can break it and let liquid leak again.
entries.intro_zh: 封口纸写着“封口浮片”；打开后，里面的材料只够使用一次。
entries.intro_en: The sealed wrapper reads “Sealing Float”; the contents are enough for one use.
entries.icon_reason: 梯形薄片表现封口浮片

entries.description_zh: 投下有限储液槽，吸入到额定容量即停，不是持续删除液体。
entries.description_en: Deploys a finite storage basin. It stops taking liquid at capacity; it does not continuously delete the flow.
entries.intro_zh: 封口纸写着“一截没有下游的河”；打开后，里面的材料只够使用一次。
entries.intro_en: The sealed wrapper reads “A River with No Downstream”; the contents are enough for one use.

entries.description_zh: 指定已见区域短时建立三处低坡通道，真实改地势且不能影响保护格。
entries.description_en: Marks a visible region and briefly establishes three low-slope channels. It changes real terrain and cannot affect protected cells.
entries.intro_zh: 封口纸写着“暴雨前的排水图”；打开后，里面的材料只够使用一次。
entries.intro_en: The sealed wrapper reads “Drainage Map Before the Storm”; the contents are enough for one use.

entries.description_zh: 武器；一发一装，装填便宜但必须每次换弹，不能无限连射。
entries.description_en: Weapon. Fires one round, then must be reloaded. Reloading is cheap, but every shot requires it; sustained fire is impossible.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，单钉装订枪旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Single-Staple Binder were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 单钉装订枪 · 弹匣与轨迹·🔫

verb.zh: 打一发后再装填
verb.en: fire one round, then reload

complement.zh: 装填便宜但不能连续射击
complement.en: reloads cheaply but cannot sustain fire

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 弹仓只有 1 发，装填要 1 步、每步花 1 点想象力：一枪一装，不能连射。

entries.icon_reason: 发射工具轮廓类比装订枪

entries.description_zh: 衣物；换弹中掉落的自己弹药留在脚下可回收，不免换弹费。
entries.description_en: Clothing. Your ammunition dropped during a reload stays at your feet for retrieval. This does not waive the reload cost.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，旧射击围裙旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Old Range Apron were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 旧射击围裙 · 弹匣与轨迹·🎽

verb.zh: 拾回换弹时落下的自有弹药
verb.en: retrieve your own ammunition dropped while reloading

complement.zh: 仍支付完整换弹代价
complement.en: the full reload cost still applies

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 换弹时把仓里没打出去的那几发落到脚下成为真实可回收弹，**不免换弹费**（费照付、步骤照走）。

entries.icon_reason: 围覆躯干的衣片类比围裙

entries.description_zh: 饰品；瞄准可见实体时显示当前射线第一拦截物，不能自动绕障。
entries.description_en: Accessory. When aiming at a visible entity, it shows the first object currently blocking the shot. It cannot route a shot around cover.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，偏心准星旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Offset Sight were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 偏心准星 · 弹匣与轨迹·⌖

verb.zh: 指出射线碰到的第一个实体
verb.en: show the first entity in the shot’s path

complement.zh: 只作提示，不替你绕过掩体
complement.en: reveals the obstruction but never routes around cover

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 沿当前射线找出第一处拦截（墙或实体）；看不见的拦截只报「有东西挡着」，不报坐标——不自动绕障。

entries.description_zh: 工具；把一发当前弹体推得更近、更重，牺牲射程，消耗原弹。
entries.description_en: Tool. Drives one loaded projectile into a shorter, heavier shot, trading away range and consuming the original round.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，弹簧推杆旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Spring Rammer were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 弹簧推杆 · 弹匣与轨迹·⎍

verb.zh: 把一发弹压成更近更重的射击
verb.en: ram one round into a shorter, heavier shot

complement.zh: 射程缩短且原弹被消耗
complement.en: range is reduced and the original round is spent

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 把下一发推重：射程 8→4、伤害 1→3，弹体在开火时才真正消耗，不额外补弹。

entries.icon_reason: 方波阶跃形类比弹簧推杆

entries.description_zh: 武器；两发分用两个真实弹仓，切口花行动，不能一键同时射。
entries.description_en: Weapon. Its two shots draw from separate, real magazines. Switching ports costs an action; both cannot fire at once.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，双口标签枪旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Twin-Port Label Gun were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 双口标签枪 · 弹匣与轨迹·⚯

verb.zh: 切换两只真实弹仓之一
verb.en: switch between two real magazines

complement.zh: 切换花行动，两仓不能同时开火
complement.en: switching costs an action; both magazines never fire together

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 两个真实弹仓各 2 发，切仓只在满仓时允许且花一次行动；一次射击只走一个仓，不能一键同射。

entries.icon_reason: 双圈双出口表现双口标签枪

entries.description_zh: 武器；空仓时可作慢速近战，装弹后改为发射，二者互斥。
entries.description_en: Weapon. When empty, it can make a slow melee attack. Loading it switches to firing, so the two modes cannot be used together.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，开膛验章器旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Seal-Splitting Proof Tool were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 开膛验章器 · 弹匣与轨迹·🔏

modifier.zh: 空仓近战与装弹射击互斥

verb.zh: 空仓时慢速近战，装弹后发射
verb.en: strike slowly while empty, or fire when loaded

complement.zh: 装弹状态决定唯一可用模式
complement.en: the loaded state selects the only available mode

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 空仓时改成慢速近战（伤 2、之后 2 回合不能再打），装弹后回到发射；两种用法互斥。

entries.icon_reason: 印章锁表现验章与开膛权限

entries.description_zh: 工具；架起后装填更稳但不能移动，移动会收起并保留已完成步骤。
entries.description_en: Tool. Bracing it steadies a reload but prevents movement. Moving folds it away while preserving completed reload steps.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，换弹脚架旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Reloading Rest were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 换弹脚架 · 弹匣与轨迹·🦿

verb.zh: 架起枪托逐步装填
verb.en: brace the stock and reload step by step

complement.zh: 移动会收架但保留已完成步骤
complement.en: moving folds it away but keeps completed steps

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 架起后装填少 1 步，但移动被拒；真走一步就收起脚架，已完成的装填步骤保留。

entries.icon_reason: 支撑腿轮廓类比换弹脚架

entries.description_zh: 工具；卸出未发射弹药，退弹耗行动，特殊耗尽型弹体不得复制回收。
entries.description_en: Tool. Unloads unfired ammunition at the cost of an action. Special projectiles that are consumed on use cannot be duplicated or recovered.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，长柄退弹钩旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Long-Handled Case Hook were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 长柄退弹钩 · 弹匣与轨迹·🪝

verb.zh: 卸出未发射的弹药
verb.en: unload an unfired round

complement.zh: 需要行动，耗尽型弹体不能回收复制
complement.en: costs an action; spent projectiles cannot be copied or recovered

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 退出一发未发射的实弹落到脚下，可以再捡回来；密封蜡枪（E16）是耗尽型，拒绝退弹、不复制。

entries.description_zh: 武器；射出一次可反折纸弹，反折取决于实际表面，可能打回自己。
entries.description_en: Weapon. Fires a paper round that can fold once; its deflection depends on the actual surface and may send it back at you.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，折角压纸枪旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Corner-Folding Paper Gun were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 折角压纸枪 · 弹匣与轨迹·⎙

verb.zh: 射出可沿真实表面折返一次的纸弹
verb.en: fire a paper round that can fold once off a real surface

complement.zh: 折返方向可能指向自己
complement.en: the reflected path may return to you

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 撞到坚实面后按实际法线折一次，折回来的弹道可能打到自己（掉 1 点清醒度）——反折取决于真实表面。

entries.icon_reason: 打印机与纸张符号表现压纸枪

entries.description_zh: 武器；一次耗两发形成分叉短弹道，两个分支分别受阻。
entries.description_en: Weapon. Spends two rounds to create a short split trajectory. Each branch is checked against obstacles separately.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，散页铆钉器旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Loose-Leaf Riveter were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 散页铆钉器 · 弹匣与轨迹·🔩

verb.zh: 耗两发形成两条短弹道
verb.en: spend two rounds to create two short branches

complement.zh: 每条分支分别检查拦截
complement.en: each branch checks obstacles separately

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 一次耗 2 发，按两条各自独立推进的短弹道（4 格）结算，两支各自被墙挡住。

entries.description_zh: 装备；持续读法：维持爆炸加压，使由你发起的真实爆炸对敌创伤增加1，对自己的清醒创伤也增加1；每次独立真实爆炸只加算一次，不增加半径、点燃强度或墙体破坏；补语读法：使本次真实爆炸对自己的清醒创伤减少1，最低为1；此收束读法不提供本件的爆炸增伤。
entries.description_en: Equipment. Sustained reading: sustain blast pressure, adding 1 enemy trauma and 1 self-inflicted Lucidity trauma to each real explosion initiated by you, once per actual explosion, without increasing radius, ignition strength or wall damage. Complement reading: reduce this real explosion's Lucidity trauma to yourself by 1, to a minimum of 1, without applying this item's blast-damage bonus.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，延迟上膛套旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Delayed-Chamber Sleeve were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 延迟上膛套 · 弹匣与轨迹·⟃

modifier.zh: 使本次由你发起的真实爆炸创伤增加1，自己被波及时同样承受加重的冲击；不改变半径与地形破坏
modifier.en: add 1 trauma to this real explosion initiated by you, including extra trauma to yourself if caught, without changing its radius or terrain damage

verb.zh: 维持爆炸加压，使由你发起的真实爆炸对敌创伤增加1，对自己的清醒创伤也增加1；每次独立真实爆炸只加算一次，不增加半径、点燃强度或墙体破坏
verb.en: sustain blast pressure, adding 1 enemy trauma and 1 self-inflicted Lucidity trauma to each real explosion initiated by you, once per actual explosion, without increasing radius, ignition strength or wall damage

complement.zh: 使本次真实爆炸对自己的清醒创伤减少1，最低为1；此收束读法不提供本件的爆炸增伤
complement.en: reduce this real explosion's Lucidity trauma to yourself by 1, to a minimum of 1, without applying this item's blast-damage bonus

attribution.zh: 加重的爆炸冲击的特性

manner.zh: 使本次由你发起的真实爆炸创伤增加1，自己被波及时同样承受加重的冲击；不改变半径与地形破坏
manner.en: add 1 trauma to this real explosion initiated by you, including extra trauma to yourself if caught, without changing its radius or terrain damage

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 原只是把换弹最后一步延期且首发更慢，没有清晰收益；改为高风险爆炸增伤。
mechanic_proposal.replaced_description_zh: 饰品；把换弹最后一步延至下一次开火前，首发因此更慢，不少付一步。

modifier.zh: 借助延迟上膛套，使本次由你发起的真实爆炸创伤增加1，自己被波及时同样承受加重的冲击；不改变半径与地形破坏。
modifier.en: Wearing Delayed-Chamber Sleeve, I add 1 trauma to this real explosion initiated by you, including extra trauma to yourself if caught, without changing its radius or terrain damage.

verb.zh: 我佩戴延迟上膛套，维持爆炸加压，使由你发起的真实爆炸对敌创伤增加1，对自己的清醒创伤也增加1；每次独立真实爆炸只加算一次，不增加半径、点燃强度或墙体破坏。
verb.en: Wearing Delayed-Chamber Sleeve, I sustain blast pressure, adding 1 enemy trauma and 1 self-inflicted Lucidity trauma to each real explosion initiated by you, once per actual explosion, without increasing radius, ignition strength or wall damage.

complement.zh: 借由延迟上膛套，使本次真实爆炸对自己的清醒创伤减少1，最低为1；此收束读法不提供本件的爆炸增伤。
complement.en: Wearing Delayed-Chamber Sleeve, I reduce this real explosion's Lucidity trauma to yourself by 1, to a minimum of 1, without applying this item's blast-damage bonus.

entries.description_zh: 衣物；允许换弹中一小步移位，次数绑定这次换弹，不可来回刷。
entries.description_en: Clothing. Allows one short reposition during a reload. The allowance belongs to that reload and cannot be refreshed by moving back and forth.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，软肩背带旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Soft Shoulder Sling were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 软肩背带 · 弹匣与轨迹·🪢

verb.zh: 换弹途中移位一步
verb.en: reposition once during a reload

complement.zh: 额度绑定本次换弹，不能来回刷新
complement.en: the allowance belongs to that reload and cannot be refreshed

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 换弹中允许走一小步：额度绑定这一次换弹，走过就置位，不能来回刷；脚架架着时仍然不许动。

entries.description_zh: 工具；吸回可见落地的自有可回收弹壳，不能从敌人体内复制弹药。
entries.description_en: Tool. Pulls back visible, landed casings that belong to you and can be recovered. It cannot copy ammunition from an enemy.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，回收员的磁嘴旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Scavenger’s Magnetic Nozzle were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 回收员的磁嘴 · 弹匣与轨迹·🧲

verb.zh: 吸回可见且属于自己的弹壳
verb.en: pull back visible casings that belong to you

complement.zh: 不复制敌人体内的弹药
complement.en: does not copy ammunition from an enemy

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 只能吸回本层 6 格内、自己留下且落在地上的弹壳，补进对应枪的仓里；弹壳只在真实落点生成，从不在敌人体内，所以没有复制来源。

entries.description_zh: 武器；只能借邻近合法镜面折射开火，无镜面不能发射。
entries.description_en: Weapon. Fires only when a nearby, compatible mirror surface can refract the shot. Without one, it cannot fire.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，镜缘短铳旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Mirror-Edge Short Gun were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 镜缘短铳 · 弹匣与轨迹·🔫

verb.zh: 借相邻合法镜面折射开火
verb.en: refract a shot through a nearby legal mirror

complement.zh: 没有可用镜面便不能发射
complement.en: cannot fire without a compatible mirror

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 只在相邻有合法镜面时从镜面起射；没有镜面整次拒绝，不消耗弹药。

entries.description_zh: 武器；弹匣最后一发形成强击退，前几发偏弱；退弹不能伪造末发。
entries.description_en: Weapon. The magazine’s final round delivers a heavy knockback; earlier rounds are weaker. Unloading cannot counterfeit a final shot.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，只认末发的枪托旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the Last-Round Stock were lined up in the exact order of the shots.
entries.source_character_name: UPPER LEFT OR LOWER RIGHT CURLY BRACKET SECTION

board_art.motif: 只认末发的枪托 · 弹匣与轨迹·⎰

verb.zh: 用弹匣末发造成强击退
verb.en: knock a target back with the magazine’s last round

complement.zh: 前发偏弱，退弹不能伪造末发
complement.en: earlier rounds are weaker; unloading cannot fake the final shot

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 弹匣最后一发（且这匣没退过弹）击退 3 格；前面几发没有击退，这就是「偏弱」的落点——退弹会清掉连击标记，伪造不出末发。

entries.description_zh: 武器；蓄势后耗满匣打一束蜡弹，沿途实际沉积材料，用完必须完整换弹。
entries.description_en: Weapon. After winding up, it empties the whole magazine into a wax shot that deposits real material along its path. It must be fully reloaded afterward.
entries.intro_zh: 射击台上，没有第二响的封蜡枪旁边的空弹壳按实际顺序排好。
entries.intro_en: The empty casings beside the No-Second-Report Wax-Seal Gun were lined up in the exact order of the shots.

board_art.motif: 没有第二响的封蜡枪 · 弹匣与轨迹·🕹

verb.zh: 蓄势后沿弹道沉积真实蜡料
verb.en: wind up and deposit real wax along the shot path

complement.zh: 耗尽整匣，用后必须完整换弹
complement.en: empties the magazine and requires a full reload afterward

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 先蓄势（满仓时点自己），再耗满匣打一束：沿途每格真的沉积一份熔融蜡烛，伤害按满匣发数算；耗尽型，不能退弹，换弹要 3 步。

entries.icon_reason: 扳机操纵器类比封蜡枪

entries.intro_zh: 弹道记录用“听出填装间隙”标记一次可确认的轨迹。
entries.intro_en: The trajectory log uses “Hear the Reloading Gap” to mark a path that can be confirmed.

entries.description_zh: 换弹的机括声每层第一次少传一格；打完的弹壳照旧留在原地。

entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆停在弹仓清空以后，名字叫作掌心的弹壳。
entries.intro_en: This memory stops just after the magazine ran dry. It is called A Casing in the Palm.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「换弹被撞断后保留一次已付准备」需要「准备记账 + 打断」两套本作没有的东西。换弹本身是真事件（`combat.py` 换弹发声 `category='item'`，完成 6 格／中途 4 格），于是改成这条声路上的一次缓冲：每层第一次换弹声少传一格。

entries.icon_reason: 金属圆帽与细柱类比弹壳轮廓

entries.description_zh: 自己开枪的声音每层第一次少传一格；命中与伤害不变。
entries.description_en: The first shot you fire each layer carries one tile less; hit and damage are unchanged.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆停在弹仓清空以后，名字叫作射击棚的耳塞。
entries.intro_en: This memory stops just after the magazine ran dry. It is called Earplugs from the Shooting Booth.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「自己的发射声造成的听觉负面积累降低，敌人听见的响度不变」绑着「听觉损伤累积」这一层，本作没有；而声径是**同一份**数值，做不到「自己少听、敌人照听」。按裁定改描述为：开枪声（`category='projectile'`）每层第一次少传一格，并明写敌人那边的范围随之小一格。

entries.description_zh: 自己反射弹的首段自伤减轻一次，不能免疫后续反射或环境爆炸。
entries.description_en: Once, reduces the first self-injury from your own reflected projectile. It does not prevent later reflections or environmental explosions.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆停在弹仓清空以后，名字叫作第一次脱靶。
entries.intro_en: This memory stops just after the magazine ran dry. It is called The First Miss.

entries.description_zh: 一次迟滞短一回合；射击伤害与命中不变。
entries.description_en: One sluggish affliction lasts one turn less; shot damage and accuracy are unchanged.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆停在弹仓清空以后，名字叫作枪托上的旧压痕。
entries.intro_en: This memory stops just after the magazine ran dry. It is called Old Dents in the Stock.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「蓄势射击受轻微扰乱时不丢一次准备」需要蓄势＋打断两套系统，本作没有。同一把枪带来的「握稳了」改成对迟滞的一次缓冲：新沾染的迟滞少一回合（`portent:sluggish` 是本作真征兆，`_grant_material_portents` 里按量削减）。

entries.icon_reason: 弯曲刻痕形表现枪托压痕

entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆停在弹仓清空以后，名字叫作没来得及换的匣。
entries.intro_en: This memory stops just after the magazine ran dry. It is called The Magazine I Never Changed.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「把一次未完成换弹封存到该实例」需要换弹进度存档＋复制防护，本作没有。按裁定改到同一条换弹声路上，但更强（少传两格）：这是「非常稀有」位的强度来源。

entries.description_zh: 弹体反折路径进入自己格前，提供一次短暂格挡缓冲，必须已感知该弹。
entries.description_en: Once, grants a brief blocking buffer before a projectile on a reflected path reaches your cell. You must have sensed that projectile.
entries.intro_zh: 这段记忆停在弹仓清空以后，名字叫作靶心背后的墙。
entries.intro_en: This memory stops just after the magazine ran dry. It is called The Wall Behind the Bullseye.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 反折路径进自己格的那一下在 `equipment/remaining_gear.py` 反折分支里，专用通道 `lucidity:self_projectile`（与「第一次脱靶」的 `mind:self_projectile` 同一口径：只挡自己反射弹那一下，不泛化成战斗护盾）；「必须已感知该弹」由反折本身成立（那是自己打的弹），不再另设前提。

mechanic_proposal.reason_zh: 消耗一份真实熔料给这次攻击留下可冷凝沉积（落在目标格），沉积同时改变自己的退路；没有熔料就不打。

entries.description_zh: 对已见线路显示断开将影响的已确认接收端，未知端只提示存在未明连接。
entries.description_en: For a visible line, shows the confirmed receivers affected by disconnecting it. Unknown endpoints are only marked as possible uncharted connections.
entries.intro_zh: 端口旁的笔记写着“先断哪根”，只标明实际验证过的连线。
entries.intro_en: A note beside the port says “Which Wire to Cut First,” and marks only connections tested in practice.

entries.description_zh: 亲眼见过一条液气反应之后，身边（脚下或四邻）再出现同样两样东西落在同一格时，先说明这一格会出什么；没见过的组合不替你反演。
entries.description_en: Once you have seen a liquid-gas reaction happen, when the same two substances meet again in a tile right beside you (your own tile or the four around it), say what that tile will turn into. A combination you have never seen is not worked out for you.
entries.intro_zh: 端口旁的笔记写着“留意产物”，只标明实际验证过的连线。
entries.intro_en: A note beside the port says “Watch the Products,” and marks only connections tested in practice.
entries.icon_reason: 反应产物的实验器皿意象

entries.name_en: A Lit Lamp Is Not a Live Wire
entries.description_zh: 对已见线路近身断开并验电后，一次接线减少积电附着；仍须实际断电，不因灯灭就安全。
entries.description_en: Once, reduces charge buildup when you disconnect and test a visible line at close range. You must actually cut the power; a dark lamp alone is not proof of safety.
entries.intro_zh: 端口旁的笔记写着“不把亮灯当通电”，只标明实际验证过的连线。
entries.intro_en: A note beside the port says “A Lit Lamp Is Not a Live Wire,” and marks only connections tested in practice.
entries.icon_reason: 闭合带电节点表现确认通电

entries.description_zh: 站在压电地板上、蓄电只差一层就要放电时给一条本地提醒；只报脚下这一格，墙后的线路它闻不出来。
entries.description_en: Standing on a piezoelectric floor one layer short of discharging gives you a local warning. It reports only the tile underfoot; wiring behind walls gives off no smell.
entries.intro_zh: 端口旁的笔记写着“熔断前的气味”，只标明实际验证过的连线。
entries.intro_en: A note beside the port says “Smell Before the Fuse Blows,” and marks only connections tested in practice.

entries.description_zh: 预览自己将提交的两个信号是否同一回合到达，未明延迟标未知。
entries.description_en: Previews whether two signals you are about to submit will arrive on the same turn. Unknown delay is shown as unknown.
entries.intro_zh: 端口旁的笔记写着“同拍才接”，只标明实际验证过的连线。
entries.intro_en: A note beside the port says “Connect Only in Sync,” and marks only connections tested in practice.
entries.icon_reason: 双点同位表现同拍接入

entries.description_zh: 倒料前提示已知产气反应的最近开放格，不保证未知路径安全。
entries.description_en: Before pouring, points to the nearest open cell known for a gas-producing reaction. It cannot guarantee the safety of an unknown route.
entries.intro_zh: 端口旁的笔记写着“反应留下出口”，只标明实际验证过的连线。
entries.intro_en: A note beside the port says “A Reaction Leaves an Exit,” and marks only connections tested in practice.
entries.icon_reason: 虚线出口箭头表现反应留出口

entries.description_zh: 首次电痉挛积累减轻，后续仍按真实暴露结算，不叠成免疫。
entries.description_en: Reduces the buildup from your first electric spasm. Later exposure still follows the real rules; this does not stack into immunity.
entries.intro_zh: 它记住的是一次真实接触留下的余温，后来被叫作握错的电池。
entries.intro_en: It remembers the warmth left by one real contact, and was later called The Battery I Held Wrong.

effect.short_en: The first shock lasts a turn less

entries.description_zh: 首次黏附熔料的时长缩短，落地材料和热伤仍存在。
entries.description_en: Shortens the duration of your first adhesion from molten solder. The material remains on the ground and can still burn you.
entries.intro_zh: 它记住的是一次真实接触留下的余温，后来被叫作冷掉的焊锡。
entries.intro_en: It remembers the warmth left by one real contact, and was later called Solder Gone Cold.
entries.icon_reason: 曲线焊条形表现冷焊锡

entries.name_en: The Fuse That Didn’t Burn Through
entries.description_zh: 一次过电短一回合；电路本身的损坏照旧结算。
entries.description_en: Being electrified lasts one turn less; damage to the circuit itself still resolves.
entries.intro_zh: 它记住的是一次真实接触留下的余温，后来被叫作没烧完的保险丝。
entries.intro_en: It remembers the warmth left by one real contact, and was later called The Fuse That Didn’t Burn Through.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「一次过载的征兆部分转为短时疲劳」——本作的「过载」不是征兆（`overclock` 是咖啡因账单，`portent:overclock` 只作为面板条目存在，没有授予点，接上去等于死通道）。按裁定改到真正的电学征兆上：过电（`charged`）少挂一回合，并保留原文「不吸收电路损坏」的边界。

entries.name_en: A Crack in the Glass Cup
entries.description_zh: 一次可燃短一回合；玻璃杯本身不会因此变结实。
entries.description_en: One flammability lasts one turn less; the glass itself does not get sturdier.
entries.intro_zh: 它记住的是一次真实接触留下的余温，后来被叫作玻璃杯里的裂纹。
entries.intro_en: It remembers the warmth left by one real contact, and was later called A Crack in the Glass Cup.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「随身反应容器第一次破损少漏一份」需要「随身容器的破损与漏液」这条链，本作没有。按裁定改成裂纹能兑现的那半句：可燃（这东西正烧着）少挂一回合，容器强度不变。

entries.name_en: The Evening the Power Went Out
entries.description_zh: 一次遮蔽短一回合；灯不会因此重新亮起来。
entries.description_en: One obscuring lasts one turn less; no lamp comes back on because of it.
entries.intro_zh: 它记住的是一次真实接触留下的余温，后来被叫作家里停电的傍晚。
entries.intro_en: It remembers the warmth left by one real contact, and was later called The Evening the Power Went Out.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「断电导致的临时准备失效可延缓一回合」需要「临时准备」与「断电」两套记账，本作没有。按裁定改成停电那一刻真正的体验：遮蔽（看不见）少挂一回合，并明写它不恢复任何设备。

entries.icon_reason: 停电时拔离的插头意象

entries.description_zh: 一次灼伤短一回合；没有冷源也不会凭空降温。
entries.description_en: One scalding lasts one turn less; without a cold source nothing actually cools down.
entries.intro_zh: 它记住的是一次真实接触留下的余温，后来被叫作烫在指尖的字。
entries.intro_en: It remembers the warmth left by one real contact, and was later called Letters Burned into a Fingertip.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「接触高温材料后可用一次冷却行动降低积累，需真实冷源」是一个**新动作**（还要查冷源），超出「小系统」的范围。按裁定改成被动的一半：灼伤少挂一回合，并保留原文那句「需真实冷源」的边界感（它不生产冷量）。

entries.icon_reason: 指尖轮廓表现烫字记忆

entries.description_zh: 费7/冷9；把一个可见端口短接到通，三回合内它一直是通的，保护端口不受影响。
entries.description_en: Cost 7 / cd 9; jumper one visible port hot for three turns — it reads as live the whole time — while protected ports stay untouched.
entries.intro_zh: 电路练习把这一步称作“短接”，不能越过未知端口。
entries.intro_en: The circuit workbook calls this move “Short-Circuit Bridge”; it cannot reach an unknown port.

entries.description_en: Cost 6 / cd 10; draw one existing component out of a visible tile into an empty container of yours, never running a reaction backwards.
entries.intro_zh: 电路练习把这一步称作“析出”，不能越过未知端口。
entries.intro_en: The circuit workbook calls this move “Precipitate”; it cannot reach an unknown port.

entries.description_zh: 费9/冷12；让一处端口上还没走完的那次信号多留一回合，超时便作废。
entries.description_en: Cost 9 / cd 12; let a signal still running at one port linger one more turn. Once it times out the chance is gone.
entries.intro_zh: 电路练习把这一步称作“缓拍”，不能越过未知端口。
entries.intro_en: The circuit workbook calls this move “Delay a Beat”; it cannot reach an unknown port.

facts.environment: 别的端口、nets、线迹与 `sequences` 都不动
facts.impact: 纯逻辑电平：不造成伤害、不放声音、不移动实体
facts.protection: 那一格没有端口、不是脉冲，或信号已经过期时，付款前拒绝

entries.description_zh: 费10/冷14；把一个已经破口的容器临时封住三回合，里面的东西不漏不灌。
entries.description_en: Cost 10 / cd 14; seal a already-cracked vessel for three turns — nothing leaks out and nothing pours in.
entries.intro_zh: 电路练习把这一步称作“封炉”，不能越过未知端口。
entries.intro_en: The circuit workbook calls this move “Seal the Furnace”; it cannot reach an unknown port.

facts.timing: 即时：登记记录并 +20 完好度

facts.environment: 只加这一格的完好度，不改墙种、不改里面的液体
facts.impact: 不造成伤害、不放声音、不移动实体

entries.source_character_name: SQUARE WITH UPPER LEFT TO LOWER RIGHT FILL

entries.description_zh: 费11/冷15；复送自己本层刚发送的一次信号，原机关次数限制不重置。

entries.intro_zh: 电路练习把这一步称作“冷铸”，不能越过未知端口。

entries.intro_zh: 铅封写着“干燥粉包”；只够完成一次安全的短接或隔离。

entries.description_zh: 替换一处合法熔丝，容许一次更长脉冲，超额仍断。

entries.intro_zh: 铅封写着“备用慢熔丝”；只够完成一次安全的短接或隔离。
entries.intro_en: The lead seal reads “Spare Slow-Blow Fuse”; it is enough for one safe connection or isolation.

entries.description_zh: 消耗后催化一种已知可结晶材料，产量受真实原料限制。
entries.description_en: When spent, catalyzes crystallization in one known material. Yield is limited by the real ingredients available.
entries.intro_zh: 铅封写着“结晶种”；只够完成一次安全的短接或隔离。
entries.intro_en: The lead seal reads “Crystal Seed”; it is enough for one safe connection or isolation.

entries.description_zh: 给已确认的合法机器一次额外操作窗口，仍付材料与费用，不重置奖励次数。
entries.description_en: Gives one confirmed, legal machine an extra operation window. Materials and costs still apply, and reward limits do not reset.
entries.intro_zh: 铅封写着“一次开工许可”；只够完成一次安全的短接或隔离。
entries.intro_en: The lead seal reads “Single-Job Permit”; it is enough for one safe connection or isolation.

effect.runtime_note_zh: 原文「首次边界环境侵扰留一回合反应窗」需要「边界侵扰」与「反应窗」两套东西，本作没有；该行的 `min_depth` 也仍是 18，而描述写「最低28」——两处都不成立。按裁定只保留这一句里真能兑现的部分：一局**一次**的环境心智缓冲（2 点，`scope=run`），与「每层一次」的其它环境缓冲不互相顶替。

entries.description_zh: 费6/冷9；结束自己一个可撤构想场，阻止后续效果，已耗材料不返。
entries.description_en: Cost 6 / cooldown 9. Ends one of your own retractable construct fields and stops its future effects. Spent materials are not returned.
entries.intro_zh: 边界练习称它为“收稿”，施展后仍受原有债务与界限约束。
entries.intro_en: The boundary workbook calls this move “Submit the Draft”; existing debts and limits still apply afterward.

facts.target: 悬停格→面朝格（kind=any、range 12、strict）：落点必须是你自己本层某个仍存活构想场覆盖的格
facts.range: 只结束落在该格上的场（同格叠多个残留就一并结束），不波及相邻格
facts.duration: 即刻：remaining 归零并从 state.construct_environments 摘除
facts.timing: 即时：付款后移除，之后 construct_environments.tick 再也看不到它
facts.spawns: 无生成物，也不新增计时器
facts.environment: 不返还原构想花掉的材料与想象力；不改地形、不清液体与气体
facts.impact: 只撤自己的场；异象的技能场在 enemy_skill_fields，本构想完全不碰
facts.protection: 该格没有自己的场则付款前拒绝（零消耗）；其他层的残留不在 active() 里，收不到

entries.description_zh: 费8/冷12；暂停自己一个未到期非伤害残留一回合，同时不能再铺该类。
entries.description_en: Cost 8 / cooldown 12. Pauses one of your own non-damaging residues for one turn. While paused, you cannot create another residue of that kind.
entries.intro_zh: 边界练习称它为“挂起”，施展后仍受原有债务与界限约束。
entries.intro_en: The boundary workbook calls this move “Suspend”; existing debts and limits still apply afterward.

entries.description_zh: 医院；费9/冷14，把一份真实恢复品施给相邻合法友方；恢复归目标，原药物债务仍由施放者支付。
entries.description_en: Hospital. Cost 9 / cooldown 14. Uses one real restorative item on a legal adjacent ally. The ally receives the recovery, while you still pay its medicine debt.
entries.intro_zh: 边界练习称它为“代为护理”，施展后仍受原有债务与界限约束。
entries.intro_en: The boundary workbook calls this move “Provide Care”; existing debts and limits still apply afterward.

facts.target: 相邻一格上的 `稳定意识`；你身上还得有一份真的恢复品
facts.range: 切比雪夫半径 1
facts.duration: 即时：恢复量一次性记到目标身上
facts.timing: 即时：先扣构想费用，再吃掉那份恢复品、把它的效力加给目标
facts.spawns: 无生成物；被吃掉的是背包里那一件
facts.environment: 只动目标的完好度（上限 100），不改地形与材料
facts.impact: 不造成伤害；`drug_debts` 一件都不动，债还挂在施放者名下
facts.protection: 那一格不是你身边的人、你身上没有恢复品、或没挨着时，付款前拒绝

entries.description_en: Library. Cost 10 / cooldown 14. Moves one of your own legal paper residues by one cell without refreshing its remaining duration.

entries.intro_en: The boundary workbook calls this move “Move the Margin”; existing debts and limits still apply afterward.

entries.description_zh: 费14/冷20；在你面朝的那格与落点之间接一条短途通行，只撑三回合、够走三趟，不跨任务门。
entries.description_en: Cost 14 / cd 20; join the tile you face and the aimed tile with a short passage that lasts three turns and carries three trips, never crossing a mission gate.
entries.intro_zh: 边界练习称它为“边界回折”，施展后仍受原有债务与界限约束。
entries.intro_en: The boundary workbook calls this move “Fold the Boundary”; existing debts and limits still apply afterward.

facts.target: 落点为空位；另一头是你面朝的那一格
facts.range: 两头相隔 2..6 格（切比雪夫），受棋盘裁剪
facts.duration: 3 真实回合；`escape` 记录到期即松开
facts.timing: 即时登记一条 `escape` 装置，踏上任一端就送过去
facts.spawns: 无生成物；本层装置表里多一条通道记录
facts.environment: 只接两头之间的一次短途通行，不挖墙、不改地势、不跨任务门
facts.impact: 不改伤害、不放声音；传送落点由 `try_escape` 判（实体或墙则不送）
facts.protection: 任一头是实体、没亲自走到过、压在机关面上，或两头相距不足 2 格时，付款前拒绝
